## Checklist

- [ ] Skill folder is **kebab-case** and contains a `SKILL.md`

- [ ] `SKILL.md` is lean (< 500 lines); long docs in `references/`, code in `scripts/`
- [ ] Added a row to the **Skill catalog** table in `README.md`
- [ ] Ran `bash scripts/validate-skills.sh` locally (and `claude plugin validate .` if available) — passes
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal data committed
